# Alta (formerly Fundnel)

Alta (formerly Fundnel) is a Financial Services company. Alta is Southeast Asia’s largest marketplace for alternative assets, licensed and regulated by MAS. They offer a platform for private companies, funds, and alternative assets to invest in, raise funds, and buy and sell tokenized securities backed by private equity, private credit, funds, luxury assets. Alta also provides fund management services and offers customized managed options. Alta (formerly Fundnel) employs 77 people (-7.2% YoY, -6 people) and has an annual revenue of $8M, founded in 2015. Headquartered in Singapore, Singapore, with an office in 18 Cross St. Its workforce is distributed across 8 countries (including Singapore, Indonesia, India, Malaysia, and Hong Kong).

## About

As Southeast Asia's largest licensed digital marketplace for alternative assets, Alta, formerly known as Fundnel, provides its end-to-end offerings around and through its blockchain-powered exchange, which brings private capital market, fund management, custodial, and other services under one roof.

As Alta, we are creating a sustainable marketplace with curated investment opportunities in alternative assets, that support a virtuous cycle of private capital growth.

# Alta

Alta is a Technology, Information and Internet company. Alta employs 52 people (+20.9% YoY, +9 people). Headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States. Its workforce is distributed across 6 countries (including United States, France, Brazil, Canada, and India).

## About

Alta is a personal style companion that simplifies the daily decision of what to wear, offering stress-free outfit suggestions based on your preferences and daily activities.

Alta is your personalized fashion companion on a mission to simplify your style choices. Named after the Latin word for "elevated," Alta acts as your daily style copilot, making the often stressful task of choosing outfits a breeze. In a rapidly growing $185 billion US apparel e-commerce industry, Alta stands out by streamlining your online shopping experience with tailored suggestions based on your unique preferences. With its AI-driven capabilities, Alta not only optimizes your closet usage but also serves as your helpful shopping assistant, ensuring your purchases fit seamlessly into your existing wardrobe. As Alta evolves, it aspires to become more than just a fashion tool, aiming to curate a lifestyle that enhances your daily experiences.

Alta has a unique partnership with Marie Kondo and her company KonMari to help organize your closet. Alta also collaborate with the CFDA, introducing our A.I.-powered platform as a tool for designers to reimagine how consumers discover, style, and shop for clothing.

properties.description:
Alta is a personal style companion that simplifies the daily decision of what to wear, offering stress-free outfit suggestions based on your preferences and daily activities.

Alta is your personalized fashion companion on a mission to simplify your style choices. Named after the Latin word for "elevated," Alta acts as your daily style copilot, making the often stressful task of choosing outfits a breeze. In a rapidly growing $185 billion US apparel e-commerce industry, Alta stands out by streamlining your online shopping experience with tailored suggestions based on your unique preferences. With its AI-driven capabilities, Alta not only optimizes your closet usage but also serves as your helpful shopping assistant, ensuring your purchases fit seamlessly into your existing wardrobe. As Alta evolves, it aspires to become more than just a fashion tool, aiming to curate a lifestyle that enhances your daily experiences.

Alta has a unique partnership with Marie Kondo and her company KonMari to help organize your closet. Alta also collaborate with the CFDA, introducing our A.I.-powered platform as a tool for designers to reimagine how consumers discover, style, and shop for clothing.
